eligibility_criteria: 1. B.Sc. Nursing/B Sc Hons. Nursing/Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing 2. Percentage of marks: Minimum 55 % aggregate of marks in the qualifying examination 3. Years of Experience: Minimum one year of work experience after B.Sc Nursing or Minimum one year of work experience before or after Post Basic B.Sc Nursing. 4. The candidate should be a regiseredNurse and registered Midwife or equivalent with any State Nursing Registration Council.
